decisions.reason: After surviving the initial post-launch screening and fitting the firm's core organic cheese range, this product likely has enough proven demand that the option value now favors continued commercialization.

As a more differentiated flavor variant it is more exposed to portfolio pruning, but because it remained after the first review period and can be kept with limited additional development cost, it is still worth keeping for now.
This mild soft cheese broadens the assortment in a mainstream direction and, having remained on offer beyond launch, likely justifies staying in the range unless later sales prove weak.
